_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Somalia covering Land of Punt, Mogadishu Sultanate, Ajuran Empire, Scramble for Africa (British/Italian/French Somaliland), Siad Barre, civil war and state collapse, piracy, Al-Shabaab, and Somaliland.

910.name: Ancient Somalia and Land of Punt
910.description: Earliest human habitation; Laas Geel rock art; ancient Land of Punt trading with Egypt; Somali pastoralism.

sub_clusters.name: Laas Geel Cave Paintings
sub_clusters.description: Neolithic cave paintings near Hargeisa depicting cattle herding; among the best-preserved in Africa.

sub_clusters.name: Land of Punt
sub_clusters.description: Ancient Somali coast identified as Land of Punt; Hatshepsut's trading expeditions; frankincense and myrrh exports.

sub_clusters.name: Origins of Somali Pastoralism
sub_clusters.description: Development of camel and cattle pastoralism; clan-based social organisation; Cushitic-speaking nomadic culture.

920.name: Medieval Somali Sultanates
920.description: Islam arrives; Mogadishu becomes major Indian Ocean trading city; rise of Somali sultanates and the Ajuran Empire.

sub_clusters.name: Arrival of Islam
sub_clusters.description: Islam reaches Somali coast early; Mogadishu and Zeila among first mosques in Africa; Somali identity intertwined with Islam.

sub_clusters.name: Sultanate of Mogadishu
sub_clusters.description: Mogadishu as powerful Indian Ocean trading sultanate; gold mint; Ibn Battuta visits 1331; cosmopolitan Swahili port.

sub_clusters.name: Ajuran Sultanate/Empire
sub_clusters.description: Ajuran Empire dominates southern Somalia; hydraulic engineering; controls Indian Ocean trade; repels Portuguese (Battle of Barawa).

sub_clusters.name: Ifat and Adal Sultanates
sub_clusters.description: Somali warriors in Ifat and Adal sultanates; Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim (Gurey) wages jihad against Ethiopia.

930.name: Post-Ajuran Somali States
930.description: Ajuran decline; successor states (Geledi, Majeerteen, Hobyo); Omani influence; European explorers arrive.

sub_clusters.name: Geledi Sultanate
sub_clusters.description: Geledi Sultanate dominates southern Somalia; agricultural wealth; defeats Omani and Ethiopian invasions.

sub_clusters.name: Majeerteen Sultanate
sub_clusters.description: Majeerteen (Migiurtinia) Sultanate controls northeastern Horn; maritime trade; resists colonial encroachment.

sub_clusters.name: Somali Clan Dynamics Pre-Colonial
sub_clusters.description: Complex clan confederacies; pastoral nomadism; Sufi orders spread Islam; resistance to external powers.

940.name: Colonial Partition of Somali Lands
940.description: Scramble for Africa partitions Somali-speaking peoples among Britain, Italy, France, and Ethiopia; Dervish resistance; colonial administration.

sub_clusters.name: Colonial Partition
sub_clusters.description: Britain takes British Somaliland (north); Italy takes Italian Somaliland (south); France takes Djibouti; Ethiopia gains Ogaden.

sub_clusters.name: Dervish State of Mohammed Abdullah Hassan
sub_clusters.description: Mohammed Abdullah Hassan ('Mad Mullah') leads 20-year anticolonial resistance; British aerial bombardment of Taleh 1920.

sub_clusters.name: Italian Fascist Colonial Period
sub_clusters.description: Mussolini's Italy intensifies control; banana plantations; brutal pacification campaigns.

sub_clusters.name: WWII and British Military Administration
sub_clusters.description: British capture Italian Somaliland; brief unification of Somali territories under British military administration.

950.name: Independence and Somali Republic
950.description: Unification of British and Italian Somaliland; pan-Somali irredentism; Siad Barre military dictatorship; Ogaden War; regime collapse.

sub_clusters.name: Independence and Unification
sub_clusters.description: British Somaliland independent 26 June; Italian Somaliland 1 July 1960; unification into Somali Republic.

sub_clusters.name: Siad Barre Military Regime
sub_clusters.description: Major General Siad Barre seizes power 1969; scientific socialism; Soviet then American alignment; clan manipulation.

sub_clusters.name: Ogaden War with Ethiopia
sub_clusters.description: Somalia invades Ethiopian Ogaden; initial success reversed by Soviet-Cuban intervention; devastating defeat; Cold War proxy dynamics.

sub_clusters.name: Civil War and State Collapse
sub_clusters.description: SNM rebellion in north; Barre regime collapses January 1991; Somalia descends into clan-based civil war.

960.name: State Collapse and Modern Somalia
960.description: Protracted civil war; humanitarian crises; Somaliland declaration; piracy; Al-Shabaab; gradual state rebuilding.

sub_clusters.name: Somaliland Declaration of Independence
sub_clusters.description: Former British Somaliland declares independence 1991; functioning democracy; unrecognised internationally.

sub_clusters.name: Battle of Mogadishu / Black Hawk Down
sub_clusters.description: UN/US humanitarian intervention; Battle of Mogadishu October 1993; US withdrawal; UN mission ends 1995.

sub_clusters.name: Somali Piracy
sub_clusters.description: Somali piracy in Gulf of Aden peaks 2011; international naval patrols; piracy suppressed but root causes remain.

sub_clusters.name: Al-Shabaab Insurgency
sub_clusters.description: Al-Shabaab Islamist insurgency; controls rural areas; Westgate and Mogadishu attacks; AMISOM/ATMIS African peacekeeping force.

sub_clusters.name: Federal Government Rebuilding
sub_clusters.description: Federal Government of Somalia established 2012; Hassan Sheikh Mohamud; fragile state-building; federalism challenges.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
